title: Rig Relay Telemetry Contribution Result v1
description: Result of a telemetry bundle contribution attempt. Contains the orchestration metadata — consent check, validation steps, upload attempt — separate from the receipt which holds destination-specific fields. No OAuth tokens, raw Drive file IDs, raw consent bodies, prompts, model outputs, source code, diffs, stdout/stderr, secrets, or private paths.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the contribution was initiated.

receipt_path.description: Filesystem path to the written receipt JSON, if successfully written.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the receipt JSON file content.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the contributed bundle.

dry_run.description: Whether the contribution was a dry run (no network upload).

upload_attempted.description: Whether an upload was attempted (dry-run or real).

upload_confirmed.description: Whether the user confirmed the upload (--confirm was passed).

consent_checked.description: Whether the consent scope check was performed.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code, present when status is a refusal or failure.

content_light_guarantee.description: Guarantee that the result contains no raw content.

steps.description: Orchestration step statuses (validate_bundle, validate_schema, check_consent, upload). Per-step status, reason, warnings, and active_scopes.

upload_receipt.description: Raw upload receipt from the Google Drive upload step. Contains bundle_id, drive_file_id (nullable), drive_folder_id, upload_method, bundle_sha256, status.
